title: Ana and Pedro
text:
Ana has a yellow kite. She flies it in the park on windy days. The kite goes very high. Ana smiles when she sees the sky.

Pedro has a blue ball. He plays football with his friends. They play every Saturday. Pedro likes to score goals.

questions.text: When do Pedro and his friends play football?
How does Ana probably feel when the kite goes high?
Why does Pedro like to play with his friends?
options: Because it is fun to play with them
Because he does not like football

vocabulary.definition: a light toy that flies in the wind on a string
when there is a lot of wind
a round object that you throw, kick, or hit
a sport where two teams try to score goals with a ball

paragraph_translations: Ana tem uma pipa amarela. Ela voa com a pipa no parque em dias ventosos. A pipa sobe muito alto. Ana sorri quando vê o céu.
Pedro tem uma bola azul. Ele joga futebol com os amigos. Eles jogam todos os sábados. Pedro gosta de marcar gols.
